title: 第11章 我这暴脾气第12章 百般刁难
lines: 和小红告别后，吴谦拿起角落的扫把，准备开始今天的功课。
两个小太监悄摸摸过来，将吴谦拦住，想要帮吴厚打扫庭院。
今天的事，药膳房有目共睹，一些聪明人，已经看出总管吴厚的态度。
上边两个领导步调不一致，下面人也立马分成两个阵营。
有人改变想法，开始准备接纳吴谦，这些人是以小柜子为主的吴厚心腹。
剩下的人，觉得范岱年轻力壮，又是尚膳监下派，认为范岱迟早要成总管，依旧不敢惹其不悦，继续保持观望。
两个太监之一，便是小柜子，有心接近吴谦，又不敢被范岱发现。
抽范岱不在的功夫，赶紧偷偷摸摸跑来，二话不说，就要接过吴谦手里的扫帚。
吴谦吓了一跳，还以为范岱让人来捣乱，赶紧把工具藏到身后，警惕的看着二人。
小柜子跟做贼似的，小声说道，“躲什么啊，我们来替你扫地！”
不是偷，是抢，抢活那就更不行了！
这可都是道德值，吴谦哪舍得让给他们，连忙严词拒绝，直言这是范岱的安排，让他们别多管闲事。
“哎呦～怎么还是个榆木疙瘩，副总管不是不在嘛，我们帮帮你，你不就能少干点！”
另一个太监尖声说道，伸手就要抢扫帚。
【小椅子，炼气境一阶】
该说不说，药膳房的太监名字……有点说法……
也不知是谁起的……
吴谦猜测，二人态度转变，应是和吴厚解围有关，于是先道了声谢，将扫帚搂在怀里说道，
“大丈夫顶天立地，有所为有所不为，既然说是让我干，那必须让我全干完！”
“天道酬勤，能骗的了他人，也骗不了天地，更骗不了自己！”
“二位的好意，吴谦心领了，告辞。”
说完抱拳一礼，快步离开此处。
两个太监被他声势所夺，慌忙抱拳还礼，目送吴谦。
人都走远了，抱着的拳还举在半空，久久忘记放下。
“这种好人不多了……”
小柜子感慨道。
小椅子连连点头，“确实是个老实人，还是个老实太监。”
吴谦一溜烟跑开老远，确定二人没跟来，才松了口气，
“娘的，还想抢老子活，做梦！”
不劳动哪来道德值。
这回他吸取教训，准备在剩下的时间里，把道德值先存起来，不再提升修为！
待安全渡过一月之期，再突破到炼气境。
到时候……
范岱的表情应该很精彩吧……
他不会直接气死吧……
content_en:
After saying goodbye to Xiaohong, Wu Qian picked up the broom in the corner and prepared to start today's homework.
Two young eunuchs sneaked over and stopped Wu Qian, wanting to help Wu Hou clean the courtyard.
What happened today is obvious to all in the medicinal kitchen, and some smart people have already seen the attitude of the manager Wu Hou.
The two leaders above were at odds with each other, and the people below were immediately divided into two camps.
Some people changed their minds and began to prepare to accept Wu Qian. These people were Wu Hou's confidants who mainly worked in small cabinets.
The remaining people felt that Fan Dai was young and strong, and that he was a subordinate of Shang Shan Supervisor. They believed that Fan Dai would become the general manager sooner or later, so they still did not dare to offend him and continued to wait and see.
One of the two eunuchs, Xiao Guizi, wanted to get close to Wu Qian, but did not dare to be discovered by Fan Dai.
When Fan Dai was away, he sneaked over quickly and took the broom from Wu Qian's hand without saying a word.
Wu Qian was startled, thinking that Fan Dai had someone come to cause trouble, so he hurriedly hid the tools behind his back and looked at the two of them warily.
The little cabinet acted like a thief and whispered, "What are you hiding from? We'll sweep the floor for you!"
It's not stealing, it's robbing, and robbing someone's life is even worse!
These are all moral values. How could Wu Qian be willing to give them up? He quickly refused and said bluntly that this was Fan Dai's arrangement and told them not to meddle in their own business.
"Ouch~ Why are you still a pimple? The deputy general manager isn't here. Let's help you, so you can work less!"
Another eunuch said sharply, reaching for the broom.
[Small chair, first level of Qi refining realm]
Should I say it or not, the name of the eunuch in the medicinal kitchen... has some explanation...
I don’t know who started it...
Wu Qian guessed that the change in their attitudes was related to Wu Hou's rescue, so he thanked him first, held the broom in his arms and said,
"A true man stands upright and does what he does and what he doesn't do. Since you say you want me to do it, you must let me do it all!"
"God rewards those who work hard. If you can deceive others, you cannot deceive heaven and earth, let alone yourself!"
"Wu Qian appreciates your kindness and takes his leave."
After saying that, he cupped his fists in salute and left the place quickly.
Overwhelmed by his momentum, the two eunuchs hurriedly returned the gift with fists clasped and watched Wu Qian go.
Everyone has walked away, but the fist they are holding is still raised in the air, and they have forgotten to put it down for a long time.
"There are not many such good people left..."
Xiaoqiang sighed.
The little chair nodded repeatedly, "He is indeed an honest man and an honest eunuch."
Wu Qian ran away in a hurry, and after making sure that the two of them were not following him, he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Damn it, you still want to steal my job, what a dream!"
There is no moral value if you don’t work.
This time he learned his lesson and planned to save his moral value in the remaining time and no longer improve his cultivation level!
After the one-month period is safely passed, he can then break through to the Qi Refining Realm.
By then...
Fan Dai’s expression should be wonderful...
He won't be so angry that he will die...
